name: WriteXmlToFile
label: Write XML to File
description: Writes the contents of an XML node or string into a file.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The path to the file where the XML will be written.

fields.name: XmlToWrite
fields.label: XML To Write
fields.description: The XML string to write into the file.

fields.name: EncodingType
fields.label: Encoding Type
fields.description: Encoding to use when writing the file.

selectOptions.label: Unicode (UTF-16)
selectOptions.description: Uses UTF-16 encoding with a BOM (Byte Order Mark).

selectOptions.label: Big Endian Unicode
selectOptions.description: Uses UTF-16 encoding without a BOM.

selectOptions.label: UTF-8 (No BOM)
selectOptions.description: Uses UTF-8 encoding without a BOM.

fields.name: FormatXml
fields.label: Format XML
fields.description: Whether to format (indent) the XML output.

fields.name: IndentationPerLevel
fields.label: Indentation Per Level
fields.description: Number of spaces to use for indentation if formatting is enabled.
